from collections import deque

def all_dist(adj, n):
    dist = []
    for s in range(n):
        d = [-1]*n
        d[s]=0
        q=deque([s])
        while q:
            u=q.popleft()
            for v in adj[u]:
                if d[v]<0:
                    d[v]=d[u]+1
                    q.append(v)
        dist.append(d)
    return dist

def footprint_from_dist(dist_s, dist_t, d, n):
    return frozenset(v for v in range(n) if dist_s[v]>=0 and dist_t[v]>=0 and dist_s[v]+dist_t[v]==d)
